name: Butterfly
desc: A stained-glass butterfly on a wandering flit-path, leaded jewel-tone wing panes with ocelli eyespots, edge-on-to-full flapping driven by the beat, seeded flight and rest, x-ray, sumi and iridescent skins.

pose.doc: flit=wander+full flap; hover=near anchor flutter; rest=perched slow-breathe; dance=beat loop-de-loop

style.doc: aesthetic: leaded jewel panes / dark glowing vein lattice (abstracted) / sumi brush wash / oil-slick angular sheen

act.doc: free=obey pose; migrate=steady cross-screen drift; emerge=rest->hover->flit over the section arc (metamorphosis)

seed.doc: deterministic pane, palette-jitter and ocelli variation
